tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grol tig zhi khro'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga sdig sgrib rgyun gcod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs zhi khro'i lha/ /'bras bu'i bcud du yongs smin pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /dbang gi cho ga 'dir gsal bya/

/de la 'di yi dbang bskur bar 'dod pas thog mar sbyor ba yo byad kyi shoms dang dbang don sgrub mchod kyi rim pa rnams phrin las 'od gsal snying po ltar dang bzlas pa'i dbur dzab khang dbye/ bzlas pa grub nas rnam bum la dmigs te/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal med khang chen por kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin lhag par gsal bar gyur/ bdag srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la/ 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs/ de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ babs pas bum chur gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la gzungs thag nas bzung ste sngags ci nus bzla/ las bum du rdo rje sems dpa' skad cig gis gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la yi ge brgya pa ci rigs bzla/ thun mthar mchod pa dang yi ge brgya pa'i rjes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dung zhal gyi chu mchod yon du drangs pas bum pa'i lha bde stong chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas bdag 'jug blang ba'am rig pa'i me tog dor/ dbang dngos la/ thog mar khrus dang*/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje phrin las gcig tu 'dus shing*/ de dag thams cad las kyang rnam thar dang bka' drin khyad par du 'phags pa/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma saṃ bha wa nyid kyi thugs kyi thig le mthar thug pa/ sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs gsum la lkog chos su bstsal ba/ pad+ma'i zhal gdams grol thig dgongs pa rang grol zhes yongs su grags shing*/ grol ba bzhi ldan gyi zab chos khyad par du 'phags pa/ lo chen bai ro tsa na'i thugs sprul/ mkhas shing grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'gro 'dul shes rab 'od zer gyis dbur stod brag ri rin chen spungs pa sogs gter gnas drug nas spyan drangs pa'i nang tshan/

sngo 'phrang klu bdud mkhar gyi gter byon/ zhi khro'i bskyed rdzogs lam 'bras snying po'i dbang bskur zab mo 'di nyid bsgrub par bgyi ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug dang gnyis su med pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: sngon chad lam log 'khor bar 'khyams: srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral slad du: bla ma zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag nyid 'jug par 'tshal bar bgyi: lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum zhi khro'i dky-il 'khor gyi lha tshogs mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bsags sbyong gi snying po bsdus pa yan lag bcu pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐: rnam dag mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las: bla ma zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags: dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul: bzhugs gsol 'debs so dge rtsa bsngo: yang dag rdo rje 'chang thob shog: lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang gi ye shes skyai ba'i rten skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ so thar/ byang sems/ rig 'dzin gyi sde snod rnams kyi bslab bya mtha' dag blangs nas/ tshul bzhin bsrung bar dam bca' ba'i blo brtan pos 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma zhi khro skyabs kyi mchog tu 'dzin: 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug sems bskyed de: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor gsang sngags kyi: dam tshig sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar bgyi: lan gsum/ de nas dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i 'gram du dbang stegs pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa la/ bdag slob dpon kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer byung*/

rnam smin gyi phung po sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa hūm̐ mthing gar gyur pa yab kyi zhal du drangs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi pad+mar babs/ phyir byung nas rang gi gdan la 'khod pas kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus su gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te snying ga nas sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bcas/ hūm̐: thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba rnams: mkha' la char ltar babs nas kyang : rnal 'byor sgo gsum rdo rjer mdzod: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: bar snang glog ltar 'khyugs nas kyang : rtsa khams rlung la ye shes spor: yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs: sa nas rlangs ltar rdol nas kyang : rig pa'i rtsal chen rang la spor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: sarba sa ma ya e ā' ral+li pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zhes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis brtan par bya'o/ /des 'jug pa'i chos grub nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: ji ltar mchog chen stsal ba bzhin: bdag kyang yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir: nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bdag slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang*/ slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam rgyal gyi bum pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐: dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste: khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi: gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī:āḥ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myangs/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor brtan pa las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes 'brel lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mdun bskyed zhi khro'i lha tshogs gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa re byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ gzhi lus phung khams skye mched rnams la thim pas bdag rtog gi dri ma sbyangs/ snang stong dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du sad par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lha tsaka rnams rim par sbyin la/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag /nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin kun la snyoms mdzad pa/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis kyis dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs su 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pas dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ oṃ swā ām̐ hā a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed mdzad ma/ /rigs kyi yum gyur rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pyām̐ tām̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rnam shes dbang po dag pa sku gsung thugs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mchog ste/ /sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ma hā sa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar can/

/nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mchod pas rgyal ba mchod/ /byang chub lha mo'i tshogs kyis dbang bskur ro/ /bo dhi de wī a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la mchod 'bul ma/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /pū dza de wī a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa/ /tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par srung*/ /ta kṛd sgo ba bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rtag chad mthar phyin gsang ba yum gyi ngang*/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma/ /sgo ma chen mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs bzhi 'jig rten 'dul mdzad gtso/ /nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyud drug dag par sbyong*/ /bcom ldan thub pa drug gis dbang bskur ro/ /sarba mu ne a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus na mngon byung ba/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dpal chen he ru ka rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /sarba shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ khro mo dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing*/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ma/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum gyis dbang bskur ro/ /sarba kro dhi shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed rgyan gyis bzhugs/ /khro mo chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ha a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*/ /'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /phra men chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /he a bhi a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi/ /shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par srung*/ /sgo skyong khro mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/

/dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badz+ra ā ral+li/ /mkha' la shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma/ /rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ de ltar lus la lha'i dbang bskur bas/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i ngo bor dag cing*/ de yang rang sems lhag pa bden gnyis dbyer med gsang chen rigs gcig tu rnam par dag pa yin no/ /de dag rnams kyi sgo nas ni/ bum pa'i dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs/ lus kyi sgrib dag kun tu 'od/ sa non zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub/ sprul sku mngon du byas pa'o/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ bdud rtsi myangs la/ hūm̐: ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis: dbang bskur sras la sbyin pa ltar: gnyis med sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu: gdan gsum ngo bos khyod dbang bskur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mgrin pa nas brgyud rtsa khams gang : gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag sgrib dag: rgyas pa'i las 'grub pad can non: rang byung rnam bzhi mngon du gyur: dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i rig ma rdo rje btsun mo'i ngo bo can spros te thar pa bsten par bskul bar gyur/ hūm̐: kun bzang thugs ka nas byung ba'i: lha mo dga' ster gnas ster ma: gzugs dang lang tsho kun ldan pa: 'di khyer rtag tu mchod pa gyis: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ: lha mo rdo rje'i lam du zhugs: snying gar brgyud de spyi bor thim: mas brtan dga' bzhi'i mthar bskyal lo: sher dbang thob nas yid sgrib dag: dbang gi las 'grub tshogs chen non:

dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du gyur: dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa byung*/ snying ga'i dbus su thim pa la brten nas byin rlabs 'pho ba'i rim pas don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long gi brdas mtshon te/ hūm̐: bde la sems bzung stong nyid ngang : srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pa: snang stong zung 'jug mtha' las 'das: rang bzhin dag pa'i don bsgom bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa'i dbang thob rba rlabs dag: drag po'i las 'grub bla ma'i sa: non zhing sgo gsum dam tshig 'dzin: ngo bo nyid sku he ru ka: ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po 'grub: ces rtog pa bskyed/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams yi ge gsum gyi rnam pas rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pas dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig /de ltar smin byed dbang bzhi'i rim pa stan thog gcig tu thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal du ma zad/ lus longs spyod kyis bsdus pas bdag tu byas pa'i bdog pa ci mchis yon du 'bul ba dang*/ dbang gi skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod kun: khyed la 'bul gyis yongs su bzhes: khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la zungs: kun kyang ye shes mchog thob shog: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams: lus dang srog gi phyir mi gtang : rin chen glang po nor bu rta: bu dang bu mo yo byad rnams: yul 'khor longs spyod bcas kun 'bul: tshe gcig grol 'gyur gdams mchog stsol:

lan gsum dang dge bsngo bcas bya/ rjes chog tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma phyin mthar dbyung bas grub bo/ /ces pa'ang rgyal dbang karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gsung bzhin phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas bsdebs pa'o// //
